notesStmt.note: This partial manuscript, drafted on the back of an envelope, contributed to the essay "Have We a National Literature?" which was published in March 1891. While some extant manuscripts that contributed to the essay date to as early as the 1850s, the phrasing in this draft is very similar to that found in the published version, suggesting it was likely composed in 1890 or early 1891.

This is a portion of a draft of an essay titled "Have We a National Literature?" which was published in the North American Review in March 1891. It was later included in Good-Bye My Fancy (1891), under the title "American National Literature."
